mesh_displace_fbm — 3D terrain op

• 数据种类:mesh → mesh

• 调用:import render3d; render3d.mesh_displace_fbm(V, F, amplitude: 'float', *, scale=None, octaves: 'int' = 4, lacunarity: 'float' = 2.0, gain: 'float' = 0.5, seed: 'int' = 0)(或 ops3d.get("mesh_displace_fbm"))

用法

用带 seed 的 fBm 噪声沿法线位移顶点,使网格变粗糙 → `(V, F)`。
